title: 260425_145127_FR_Steam_train_arriving_at_Le_Crotoy by kevp888
author: kevp888
sourceDescription: Steam train arriving at Le Crotoy station. I made this recording during ‘’La fête de la vapeur’’ (The Steam Festival), held in La Baie de Somme (north of France), at the end of April 2026. Here, one can hear the atmosphere in Le Crotoy train station, while one of the steam trains exhibited and used during the festival was coming. First, one can hear the stationmaster’s whistle, then the train whistling and arriving slowly, as well as the crowd’s reaction. Recorded in April 2026 with a Zoom H5studio and its Zoom XYh-5s stock microphone. Fade in/out applied in Audacity.
modifications: cut 0.15-6.15s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -21.60 dBFS); 30 ms fades
